VF.name: ViewForge | BI Dashboard
VF.description:
ViewForge | BI Dashboard is a HIPAA compliant, AI assisted revenue and follow up operating system for orthodontists and general dentists performing high-ticket treatments. This Statement of Work covers the MVP Phase 1 build and the subsequent growth phases.

Objectives: negotiate treatment pricing and payment plans deterministically through AI assisted conversations; improve case acceptance rates by 10-15% through realtime treatment coordinator coaching; collect down payments and recurring payments securely; track and recover deferred cases through structured observation workflows; maintain full auditability and financial governance while keeping decision authority with the practice.

Key deliverables: three layer financial firewall architecture (conversational layer, deterministic constraint engine, ledger layer); patient negotiation portal with AI assisted coaching; treatment coordinator chairside tablet application; payment processing integration with PHI shield architecture; observation recall and follow-up system; HIPAA compliant infrastructure and audit logging; web based staff dashboards for operations and financial visibility.

HS.name: HyperScale | Scalability Engine
HS.description:
Engagement scope for HyperScale | Scalability Engine: migrate the remaining on-premise services to a managed cloud platform and modernise the surrounding delivery tooling.

Phase 1 covers discovery and dependency mapping across the existing estate, including a documented inventory of services, data stores, scheduled jobs and third-party integrations. Phase 2 covers the lift-and-shift of stateless services behind a load balancer, with blue/green cutover and rollback runbooks. Phase 3 covers data migration with dual-write verification, followed by decommissioning of the legacy hosts.

Out of scope: application rewrites, schema redesign, and any change to the existing authentication provider. Success is measured by cutover completed with no unplanned downtime beyond the agreed maintenance window, and by p95 latency remaining within 10% of the pre-migration baseline.
